title: AI Fruit Drama Generator
summary: Make AI fruit drama videos. Describe the fruit characters and the scandal, and Flick makes each scene. See 8 soap opera scenes with their prompts.
body_markdown:
### What is AI fruit drama?


AI fruit drama is a short video format where AI-made fruit characters act out soap opera plots such as cheating, breakups and family feuds. It spread on TikTok, where series of short episodes follow the same fruit characters.


### Can I make an AI fruit drama for free?


Yes, you can start free: you get 100 credits when you sign up, 200 more for joining the Flick Discord, and 100 credits every week. The scenes on this page used GPT Image 2.5 and MiniMax H3 Fast, which both run on the free plan, and downloads carry a Flick watermark until the Standard plan.


### How do I keep the same fruit characters in every scene?


Make one image of each character and cite it as a reference in every scene, describing them the same way each time. A short line such as the strawberry in the floral apron keeps the model on the same character.


### How long should an AI fruit drama episode be?


Most episodes are short enough for one sitting on a phone, often a minute or two, built from five to eight scenes with one dramatic beat each.


### Can the fruit characters talk?


Yes. Add voices with Flick's character dialogue or a narrator voice, and put the lines in the order of the scenes on the timeline.
